system.description: Owing to your control over the living essence, you can create original effects using yours and other creatures' blood as a basis. By focusing your power, you can detect the heart rate of other creatures, speed or slow your own heart rate, raise or lower your body temperature, or createother blood-related effects at the discretion of the Judge. When you test the limits of your abilities with this feature, the Judge may call for a MIGHT | MAGIC check to determine the efficacy.
